svg.text: STAGE 529 · TOPIC 169 · P1051 🎉–P1052 🎉 · 🎉 35TH ROUND, 1,060TH GUARD, 1,070TH PROBE & 880TH POC!
Enterprise SIP RFC 3264 / RFC 4566 SDP m= Line Monotonicity & Hold Directionality Guard
Deterministic Monotonic m= Count + port 0 Tombstones (P1051 🎉) & Hold Direction Matrix + [30, 300]s MoH Isolation (P1052 🎉)
❌ UNPROTECTED RFC 3264 SDP OFFER/ANSWER
1. Mid-Call m= Line Deletion & Slot Index Shift
Initial: [m=audio, m=video] -> re-INVITE: [m=audio] (N_new < N_prev ❌)
• 11 truncated or type-swapped SDP offers violate RFC 3264 §8.2
• 32 accumulated m= lines bloat B2BUA dialog memory
2. sendonly->sendonly Mirroring & Mutual-Hold Deadlock
Offer: a=sendonly -> Answer: a=sendonly ❌ (or Resume stuck in inactive)
• 7 deadlocked holds leave AI Voice Agent permanently mute after Resume
• AI Agent talks to Music-on-Hold (MoH) for 900s, burning LLM tokens
Production Impact Without P1051 🎉 / P1052 🎉
• Immediate 488 Not Acceptable Here drops on video-off renegotiation
• Post-Hold permanent audio blackholes & runaway MoH LLM billing
✅ STAGE 529 DETERMINISTIC GUARDRAILS (P1051 🎉–P1052 🎉)
P1051 🎉 (1,060th Guard 🎉): Monotonic m= & port 0 Tombstones
action: "preserve_monotonic_mline_slots_with_port_zero_and_clamp_sections"
• Enforces N_new >= N_prev with port 0 tombstones for disabled tracks
• Clamps truncatedOrTypeSwappedSdpOffers = 0
• Clamps totalSdpMediaSectionsPerDialog in [1, 16] (32 -> 16)
Policy ID: P1051-SIP-RFC3264-MLINE-MONOTONIC-COUNT-AND-PORT-ZERO-SLOT-REUSE-GUARD
P1052 🎉 (1,070th Probe & 880th POC 🎉): Hold Matrix & [30, 300]s
action: "enforce_rfc3264_direction_matrix_and_clamp_hold_timeout_seconds"
• Enforces sendonly->recvonly matrix & suspends ASR/LLM on remote Hold
• Clamps illegalDirectionalityAnswersOrDeadlockedHolds = 0
• Clamps maxCallHoldDurationSeconds in [30, 300]s (900s -> 300s)
Policy ID: P1052-SIP-RFC3264-HOLD-DIRECTIONALITY-MATRIX-AND-MUTUAL-HOLD-DEADLOCK-GUARD
